description: Changes a design: words, sizes, colours, the photo, a look (an art-directed effect stack), another format beside it. If the person has the design open, they watch it happen live (your cursor and a bubble say what you do); otherwise it is saved as a new version (the previous one stays in the history); no design is deleted. Looks need the design open in Paletoo (the person’s editor applies them).

add_format.description: the same design in another format, beside it

bigger.description: a text’s size × by (1.25 = a quarter bigger, 0.8 = smaller); e.g. { "role": "headline", "by": 1.2 }

colour.description: a palette colour (get_design lists them) swapped everywhere; e.g. { "from": "#e2231a", "to": "#1c7ed6" }

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

eyebrow.description: the small line near the headline (a date, a tag)

headline.description: the big line, 2–5 words (\n breaks a line); e.g. «Grand\nopening»

look.description: a look for the whole artboard (needs the design open in Paletoo)

person.description: a person’s name (a card’s, a guest of honour’s, a quote’s author)

photo.description: words: a new photo for the biggest photo frame

replace.description: words replaced wherever they stand; e.g. [{ "find": "Sat", "replace": "Sun" }]

share.description: turns the design's share link on: ONLY when the person asked in this conversation for a link to send: «view» (anyone with it looks) or «edit» (anyone signed in edits). Ask the person first; never share on your own. Otherwise leave it out: only the owner sees the design.

title.description: a person’s job or a card’s tagline

name: modify_design
title: Change a design
